title: Admin user listing and admin signup gated by special password

requirements.text: Ensure an admin can view a complete list of all registered users via the existing admin user management UI, and ensure non-admin users are blocked from accessing the user list.
acceptanceCriteria: When logged in as an admin, the existing Admin Users page successfully loads and displays all users returned by the backend (not only the current user).
When logged in as a non-admin, attempting to access the Admin Users page shows an access denied screen and the backend rejects user-list requests with an authorization error.
The backend `listUsers` API remains admin-only and returns all user profiles stored in the canister.

requirements.text: Add an admin signup path where selecting the Admin role during signup requires entering the special admin signup password exactly: "Hans@987123"; if the password is missing or incorrect, the signup must fail with a clear, user-facing error message in English.
acceptanceCriteria: The signup UI allows choosing between Engineer and Admin account type.
If Admin is selected and the password is not exactly "Hans@987123", the user cannot complete signup and sees an English error message indicating the admin signup password is invalid.
If Admin is selected and the password is exactly "Hans@987123", the frontend sends an admin signup request to the backend and the created profile is stored with role Admin.
The backend enforces the admin signup password check server-side (not just in the UI).
The admin signup password is never persisted in canister state and is not included in any frontend debug logs or error logs.

requirements.text: Update frontend signup error translation so that backend failures related to invalid/missing admin signup password are displayed as a concise, user-friendly English message without exposing internal details.
acceptanceCriteria: When the backend rejects an admin signup due to incorrect password, the UI shows a user-friendly English message (e.g., "Invalid admin signup password.").
Error handling does not echo the admin password back to the user and does not include stack traces or internal backend details.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not persist or log the admin signup password; it must not be stored in canister state or in frontend logs.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is used).
Adding real-time updates for the user list.
Adding password-based authentication (the admin signup password is only a gate for role selection, not an auth system).
